name: Napa to Sonoma Wine Country Half & 5K
heroImageAlt: Runners through vineyard roads between Napa and Sonoma wine country
logoAlt: Napa to Sonoma Wine Country Half Marathon & Rosé 5K

items.label: EARLY PACKET PICK UP
items.note: All distances. Sonoma Community Center. No parking on-site — park downtown and walk ~5 min along E Napa Street. You must pick up your own bib; no proxies on Friday.

items.label: VIP WELCOME RECEPTION
items.note: Ticket required ($60). Unlimited wine, appetizers, packet pick-up, VIP gift, and prize drawing. Sonoma Community Center.

items.label: ROSÉ 5K PACKET PICK UP
items.note: Sonoma Plaza, 453 1st Street E (in front of City Hall). No dogs permitted in Sonoma Plaza.

items.label: ROSÉ 5K RACE START
items.note: Start and finish at Sonoma Plaza, 453 1st Street E, Sonoma, CA 95476. Rosé 5K finishers can redeem their rosé tasting in the Rosé Garden after the race.

items.label: RACE EXPO & HALF MARATHON PACKET PICK UP
items.note: Sonoma Plaza. Saturday proxies may collect for up to 3 people with photo ID and confirmation email. Shop merchandise, visit vendors, and enjoy photo opportunities.

items.label: RACE SHUTTLES TO START LINE
items.note: From Downtown Sonoma (1st Street E & E Spain St), Sonoma Valley High School, and Best Western Inn at the Vines — Napa (100 Soscol Ave). Last shuttle at 6:00 AM.

items.label: HALF MARATHON RACE START
items.note: Cuvaison Estate Wines, 1221 Duhig Rd, Napa, CA 94559. No parking at start — shuttle or drop-off only. Drop-off deadline: 6:15 AM at Domaine Carneros.

items.label: POST-RACE WINE FESTIVAL
items.note: Sonoma Plaza. Included with all Half Marathon and Pairing entries. 30+ Napa and Sonoma wineries. Live entertainment and exclusive photo ops.

items.label: RETURN SHUTTLES TO NAPA
items.note: Departing from Downtown Sonoma (1st St E & E Spain St) every 30 minutes. Drop-off at Best Western Inn at the Vines, 100 Soscol Ave, Napa.

hours.label: Race Expo & Half Marathon Pick-Up — Saturday

notes: Friday early pick-up requires you to be there in person — no proxy pick-up on Friday.
Saturday proxies can collect for up to 3 people with a photo ID and your confirmation email.
Half Marathon: Race Day Packet Pick-Up on Sunday is available for a fee or is included with the VIP add-on — purchase via your ACTIVE MyEvents account.
Pairing participants receive two bibs — one for the Rosé 5K, one for the Half Marathon. Wear the correct bib for each race.
To switch distances (half marathon ↔ 5K), visit the Solutions Table at the Race Expo on Saturday.
Dogs are not permitted in Sonoma Plaza.

courseInfo.strollerPolicy: Contact the race team for stroller policies specific to this event.
courseInfo.dogPolicy: Dogs are not permitted on the course or in Sonoma Plaza. Service animals specifically trained to aid a person with a disability are permitted.
courseInfo.aidStations: Half Marathon aid stations at Miles 2, 4.2, 6.4, 7.7, 9.5, and 11.4. Water and electrolytes at all stations; energy chews at Mile 7.7. Rosé 5K has one water station at the midway point, plus a rosé tasting station on course (21+ with ID required). Rosé 5K course time limit: 1.5 hours. Half Marathon course time limit: 3.5 hours (approx. 16:30/mile).
courseInfo.recoveryFood: Bite Boxes featuring locally sourced charcuterie and snacks by LaBella Charcuterie and True Story Foods. Pre-order in advance — limited quantities available on-site. Pick up at the Bite Box tent behind Sonoma City Hall at the Expo.

raceMorning.dropOffNote: Drop-off location: Domaine Carneros, 1240 Duhig Road, Napa, CA. All drop-offs must be completed by 6:15 AM — vehicles will not be allowed to turn onto Duhig Rd after 6:15 AM. Exit back on Duhig Rd toward CA-Hwy 121. Do NOT stop on Hwy 121 or on Duhig Rd — CHP will be patrolling and you may be ticketed. From the drop-off, participants walk approximately 0.3 miles up the path to the start at Cuvaison Estate Wines. Note: parking is not available at Huckleberry Breakfast & Lunch or Best Western Inn at the Vines.

spectators.notes: The half marathon course runs through rural vineyard roads, so spectator access along the route is limited. Best place to cheer is at the finish line at Sonoma Plaza, which is open to the public. The Wine Festival area is also public — guests without a tasting pass can enjoy the music, food, and atmosphere.
warnings: There is no parking at the start line at Cuvaison Estate Wines.
Duhig Rd will not allow vehicle access after 6:15 AM.
Do not park or stop on Hwy 121 or Duhig Rd — CHP is patrolling.
spectators.shuttleAccess: Spectators can take the pre-race shuttle to the start line (runners get priority). Return shuttles run from Downtown Sonoma to Best Western Inn at the Vines (Napa) every 30 minutes, 9:30 AM – 12:30 PM.

postRace.finishLineInfo: The finish line is at Sonoma Plaza, followed immediately by the post-race Wine Festival (9:30 AM – 12:00 PM). Half Marathon and Pairing participants receive wine festival access with their entry. The Pairing combo medal is available at the Pairing Combo Medal tent in the Race Expo after completing the half marathon — medals must be collected on-site and will not be mailed. Age group and overall awards are available for both the Rosé 5K and the Half Marathon.

wineFestival.location: Sonoma Plaza, 453 1st St E, Sonoma, CA
wineFestival.description: The post-race Wine Festival features tastings from 30+ Napa and Sonoma Valley wineries, live entertainment, exclusive photo ops, and your commemorative wine glass to take home. Access is included with all Half Marathon and Pairing entries. Rosé 5K participants may purchase a discounted festival pass at registration. Note: the Rosé 5K is on Saturday; the Wine Festival is on Sunday.
tips: Entry to the festival grounds is free and open to the public. Tastings are exclusive to Wine Festival Pass holders — but everyone can enjoy the music, food, and atmosphere.
Guest passes: all race participants can purchase up to 2 guest wine festival passes while supplies last. Add at registration or via your ACTIVE MyEvents account.
Wine glass pick-up and festival access begins at 9:30 AM on Sunday at Sonoma Plaza. Bring your race bib or guest pass ticket.
All participants 21+ must show ID to receive a wristband before tasting. Save time by getting your wristband at the ID Check station on Friday or Saturday.
Dogs are not permitted in Sonoma Plaza per City of Sonoma ordinance. Service animals only.
wineFestival.guestPasses: All race participants can purchase up to 2 guest wine festival passes while supplies last. Add during registration or via your ACTIVE MyEvents account at myevents.active.com.
wineFestival.finishLineVIP: Finish Line VIP ($125): private seating at Sonoma Plaza, catered brunch, exclusive wine pours, VIP gear check, changing tents, post-race massage, and an N2S gift bag. Start & Finish Line VIP Bundle ($180): all Finish Line VIP perks plus light breakfast, coffee, private restrooms, indoor waiting space, and scenic photo ops from Cuvaison's tasting room patio. Upgrade via myevents.active.com.

items.question: Can someone pick up my bib for me?
items.answer: Not on Friday — early pick-up requires you to be present in person. On Saturday at the Race Expo, a proxy can collect for up to 3 people with a digital copy of your driver's licence and your confirmation email.

items.question: Can I do Race Day Packet Pick-Up for the Half Marathon?
items.answer: Yes — Race Day Packet Pick-Up on Sunday is available for a fee or is included with the VIP add-on. Purchase via your ACTIVE MyEvents account (myevents.active.com), click 'Purchase merchandise' and select 'Race Day Packet Pick-Up' or 'VIP'.

items.question: Can I switch race distances?
items.answer: Yes, if capacity allows. Visit the Solutions Table at the Race Expo on Saturday to request a switch between the half marathon and the 5K.

items.question: Is there parking at the half marathon start line?
items.answer: No. There is no parking at Cuvaison Estate Wines. Take one of the complimentary pre-race shuttles from Sonoma or Napa, or arrange a drop-off at Domaine Carneros by 6:15 AM.

items.question: Where do the Napa shuttles depart from?
items.answer: The Napa shuttle departs from Best Western Inn at the Vines, 100 Soscol Ave, Napa, CA. Nearby parking options include South Napa Market Place (255 Soscol Ave), Century Napa Valley & XD (195 Gasser Dr), and Napa Valley College (2277 Napa Vallejo Hwy). Note: parking is not available at the Best Western itself.

items.question: What time do shuttles leave?
items.answer: Shuttles run continuously from 5:15 AM to 6:00 AM from all pickup locations. Do not miss the last shuttle — Duhig Rd closes to vehicles at 6:15 AM and there is no other way to access the start line.

items.question: What are the half marathon pacers?
items.answer: Pacers from Napa Valley Vinerunners will be in the start corral with goal finish time signs. Pace groups: 1:35, 1:40, 1:45, 1:50, 2:00, 2:15, 2:30, 2:45, 3:00, and 3:30.

items.question: What is the course time limit?
items.answer: Rosé 5K: 1.5 hours. Half Marathon: 3.5 hours (approx. 16:30 per mile). Due to rural roads on the half marathon course, participants falling behind pace may be moved ahead by the sweep vehicle.

items.question: How do awards work?
items.answer: Top 3 male and female finishers overall, and top 3 male and female in each age group, receive an award in both the Rosé 5K and the Half Marathon. Age groups: 20 & Under, 21–24, 25–29, 30–34, 35–39, 40–44, 45–49, 50–54, 55–59, 60–64, 65–69, 70–74, 75–79, 80+. Awards must be collected on-site at the Age Group Awards table in Sonoma Plaza in front of Sonoma City Hall. Awards will not be mailed after the race.

items.question: Can friends and family track me during the race?
items.answer: Yes — athlete tracking is available via the race tracking website (link coming soon) or by downloading the app and signing up for text updates from spots along the course. Check the race website for the tracking link closer to race day.

items.question: How does the Wine Festival work — do guests need a ticket?
items.answer: Entry to the festival grounds is free and open to the public. Wine tastings are exclusive to Wine Festival Pass holders. Half Marathon and Pairing participants receive festival access with their entry. Rosé 5K participants can purchase a discounted pass at registration. All race participants can add up to 2 guest passes via myevents.active.com.

items.question: I'm running The Pairing — how does it work?
items.answer: Pairing participants get two bibs — one for the Saturday Rosé 5K and one for the Sunday Half Marathon. Wear the correct bib for each race. After completing the half marathon, collect your Pairing combo medal at the dedicated tent in the Race Expo.

items.question: How does gear check work for the half marathon?
items.answer: Gear check opens at 5:30 AM and closes at 11:30 AM. Drop your bag at Cuvaison Estate Wines before the race — it'll be transported to Sonoma Plaza for pickup at the finish. Use the clear bag provided at bib pick-up and attach the gear check tag. No luggage or large bags accepted.

items.question: What is on the Rosé 5K course?
items.answer: One water station at the midway point, plus a rosé tasting station on course for participants 21+ (ID required). After finishing, all 21+ participants can visit the Rosé Garden in Sonoma Plaza for a rosé tasting from Meadowcroft Wines.
